created_by_hypothesis: CacheManager frequency-aware eviction (HTM-EAR arXiv:2603.10032) -- frequencyWeight/evictionScanWindow tuning
gold_data_source: synthetically generated by scripts/bench-cache-eviction.mjs from the seeds below; 'golden' keys = the true top-decile most-accessed keys in each generated access trace, computed independently of any cache eviction policy before the trace is replayed
notes: Each task replays a deterministic Zipfian-skewed key-access trace (seeded PRNG, no external data) through a real CacheManager instance (not a simulation/reimplementation) with maxSize well below numKeys, forcing eviction. Metric: fraction of golden (truly highest-frequency) keys still resident at the end of the trace, plus ops/sec throughput. This benchmark was authored tonight specifically to evaluate tonight's own candidate -- see the periodic corpus-fairness caveat in the issue/PR (STEP 10): it has not yet been run against an unrelated weak candidate to prove it has teeth, which is disclosed as a limitation, not resolved.
